q1_issues.issue: The coordinated locative "in homes and public" is stacked as two `Location` atoms on one event - the collective shape - where the coordination default replicates the whole predication once per conjunct, the collective form being reserved for reciprocal/aggregate predicates or a bare "together"/"jointly" marker.

q2_gaps: coordination inside an oblique PP ("in homes and public") - the distributive default is stated for coordinated noun phrases generally but is only ever illustrated on subjects and direct objects, leaving "one event per conjunct" vs "two role atoms on one event" undecided for an oblique's object
notes: Name handling follows the rule exactly - "the Durga puja" gives `(Name durga "Durga")` plus the separate kind atom `(Member durga puja)`, with no modifier genus - and the agentless passive correctly omits the Agent while the bare simple present correctly takes no status atom. `Patient` for the performed ritual is defensible under the occurrence-altering test, though `Theme` would be the unclear-case default.
